scripts.api:build: cd api && mvn clean package && cd ..
scripts.core:dev: cd api-core && DOTNET_WATCH_RESTART_ON_RUDE_EDIT=1 dotnet watch run
scripts.core:check: cd api-core && dotnet build && dotnet test && cd ..
scripts.web:build: cd web && npm run test && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.electron:build: cd web && npm run electron:build && cd ..
